id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

name.description: A short human label for the inspection (defaults to the building name + date).

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

building.description:
The {@link Building} this inspection belongs to. Optional so an inspection can
be captured against a free-text {@link ThermalInspection#buildingName} before a
formal Building record exists; the app normally finds-or-creates the Building.

buildingName.description:
Denormalized building name as entered on the inspection form, kept on the
record so reports render without a join.

status.description:
Workflow status. One of 'Needs Review', 'Under Investigation', 'Verified',
or 'Resolved'.

notes.description: Optional inspector notes captured on the upload form.

indoorTempC.description: Optional indoor air temperature at inspection time, in degrees Celsius.

outdoorTempC.description: Optional outdoor air temperature at inspection time, in degrees Celsius.

originalImage.description:
The actual uploaded thermal image, stored as a base64 `data:` URL so it can be
rendered directly in the browser. This is the real user-provided image — never
a stock substitute.

annotatedImage.description:
A base64 `data:` URL of the thermal image with candidate-anomaly bounding boxes
drawn on it, produced from the detected regions for the printable report.

imageWidth.description: Pixel width of the uploaded image.

imageHeight.description: Pixel height of the uploaded image.

summary.description:
AI-generated plain-language summary of the overall observations for this
inspection, written with cautious, verification-oriented framing.

priority.description:
Qualitative inspection priority derived from the findings: 'Low', 'Medium',
or 'High'. Not a quantitative energy estimate.

anomalyCount.description: Number of candidate {@link ThermalAnomaly} regions recorded for this inspection.

analyzed.description: True once {@link ThermalInspection#analyze} has run and findings exist.

isDemo.description:
True for clearly-labeled synthetic demonstration inspections generated by the
app's demo loader, so they can be visually distinguished from real analyses.

anomalies.description:
All candidate anomalies found in this inspection. Inverse of
{@link ThermalAnomaly#inspection}.

title:
One thermal inspection: a session in which a user uploaded an infrared thermal
image of a building and ran HeatLeak AI's assisted anomaly screening on it.

The uploaded image is stored on the record ({@link ThermalInspection#originalImage})
together with the AI-written {@link ThermalInspection#summary} and the individual
{@link ThermalAnomaly} findings reachable through {@link ThermalInspection#anomalies}.

All results are **preliminary screening observations requiring verification** — a
thermal anomaly is not a confirmed building defect.
name: ThermalInspection
